sentinel2_ndvi.source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A via Element 84 Earth Search (AWS Open Data)
sentinel2_ndvi.processing: NDVI=(B08-B04)/(B08+B04); SCL classes 0,1,2,3,7,8,9,10,11 and zero-valued reflectance are masked. RGB preview uses a 2nd-98th percentile visual stretch.

sentinel2_rgb.source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A via Element 84 Earth Search (AWS Open Data)
sentinel2_rgb.processing: RGB natural color B04/B03/B02 with visual stretch.

nasadem_elevation.source: NASA/JPL/USGS NASADEM HGT v001 via Microsoft Planetary Computer
nasadem_elevation.processing: NASADEM elevation clipped to the municipal boundary; the preview colors indicate relative elevation.

limitations: Sentinel-2 cloud cover is reported per tile; valid coverage is calculated after SCL masking within the municipal boundary.
NDVI is a vegetation index, not a crop identification or parcel-level agronomic diagnosis.
NASADEM is a terrain model derived primarily from SRTM, not a field elevation survey.
Products represent the municipality and do not resolve individual farms or parcels.
